details:
Description

Hello VRChat team,

I am experiencing a mouse cursor bug in VRChat on Windows PC.

When I switch to another application using Alt+Tab and then return to VRChat, a blue arrow cursor remains visible on the screen and follows my mouse movement.

The cursor is visible both in VRChat and in OBS Studio when using Game Capture. This is especially problematic when streaming or recording gameplay.

Steps to reproduce:

1. Launch VRChat in Desktop mode.

2. Press Alt+Tab to switch to another application.

3. Press Alt+Tab again to return to VRChat.

4. Observe that the blue arrow cursor remains visible on the screen.

Expected result:

The blue arrow cursor should disappear when returning to VRChat.

Actual result:

The blue arrow cursor remains visible and moves with the mouse, even when the VRChat menu is closed.

Platform: Windows PC

Thank you for your time and for looking into this issue.

Reproduction Steps

1. Launch VRChat in Desktop mode.

2. Press Alt+Tab to switch to another application.

3. Press Alt+Tab again to return to VRChat.

4. A blue arrow cursor appears and remains visible inside VRChat, even when the menu is closed.

5. The cursor is also visible in OBS Studio when using Game Capture.

This issue occurs consistently. I have not found a reliable workaround yet.
